stated: Introduce a new levy on tobacco company profits to help fund healthcare and smoking cessation services.

source.quote: Introducing a new levy on tobacco company profits to help fund healthcare and smoking cessation services.

bearing_set.reason: The levy explicitly funds healthcare and smoking cessation services, directly affecting NHS capacity, smoking-related disease burden, and access to cessation support — all core O3 indicators.

membership_note: Single-target policy: the revenue mechanism (levy on tobacco profits) feeds directly into O3 via funded healthcare and cessation services. No non-negligible cross-outcome harms clear the bar: pass-through to consumer tobacco prices is much weaker for a profit-based levy than an excise duty (no direct marginal-cost additive), so O2 harm is speculative; the levy is earmarked spending rather than deficit reduction, making the net O12 effect roughly neutral; UK direct tobacco-sector employment is too small to move O4 or O13 materially.
